# Craft Budapest 2026 – Copilot Instructions

This workspace contains notes for attending Craft Conference 2026 in Budapest.

## Project Files

- `craft-budapest-2026.md` — Overview, logistics, keynotes, workshops
- `craft-budapest-day-1.md` — Full Day 1 schedule (Thursday, June 4)
- `craft-budapest-day-2.md` — Full Day 2 schedule (Friday, June 5)

## How to Read the Program from the Website

The schedule is at **https://craft-conf.com/2026/schedule**.

The page uses a day selector (Day 1 / Day 2 dropdown) to switch between days — only one day's content is visible at a time. To get the full program you must:

1. Open the schedule page in a browser.
2. Read the Day 1 content (default view).
3. Click the **Day 1** button to expand the dropdown, then select **Day 2**.
4. Read the Day 2 content from the updated page.

Each time slot block contains one or more parallel sessions across these stages:
- Main Stage, Platform 2, Focus Platform, Yellow Stage, Telekom Stage, Purple Stage, Green Stage, Innovation Stage, Podcast Stage, Tech Leaders' Lounge, Central Workshop Area, 🚂 Train Tracks, Sponsor Arena

Each session entry shows: time range, stage name, session title, and speaker name(s) with links.

> Note from the site: *Specific timings of sessions, breaks, start and end timings are subject to change.*

## Updating the Schedule

When refreshing schedule data from the website:
- Use `open_browser_page` / `read_page` to load the schedule, then click the Day 2 option to switch days.
- Store Day 1 content in `craft-budapest-day-1.md` and Day 2 content in `craft-budapest-day-2.md`.
- Keep the tables ordered by time, with all parallel sessions grouped under the same time slot.
